grimoire.eclipse.cover.1:
§c§lGRIMOIRE OF THE ECLIPSE
 
§0RECORD OF OBSERVATIONS ON THE SUPERNATURAL
grimoire.eclipse.cover.2:
§0This tome contains observations on the §5Abyss§0, its manifestations, and the main supernatural lineages found in the known world.
§8Author's Note: §0These records were compiled from accounts, experiments, encounters, and field observations
grimoire.eclipse.cover.3: in the field. Some conclusions remain provisional. §0The distinction between supernatural phenomenon, organism, and entity remains unsatisfactory. In many cases, the same principle appears to produce manifestations
grimoire.eclipse.index.1:
of completely different natures.

§0§lINDEX
§cI. Vampirism
§6II. Path of the Wolf
§3III. Order of Silver
§5IV. Cult of the Abyss
§2V. Bestiary
§4VI. The Eclipse
§4VII. Rituals and Altars
§5VIII. The Abyss
§6IX. Abilities
grimoire.eclipse.vampire.1.1:
§7X. The Silver Forge
§4XI. Commands
 
§c§lI. VAMPIRISM
§0Vampirism appears to be a transmissible condition of hematic nature.
Infection may occur after being bitten by a §cVampire§0 or by ingesting §cCorrupted Blood§0.
grimoire.eclipse.vampire.1.2:
§0Complete transformation requires exactly §c3 days in total§0.
§8Author's Note: §0The progression observed does not correspond to a simple disease. Physiological changes arise before complete transformation, indicating
grimoire.eclipse.vampire.2.1:
a gradual restructuring of the organism. 
§c§lVAMPIRE: ADVANTAGES
§4✦ Attributes§0
Strength and Speed are passively amplified.
§4✦ Senses§0
Visual perception in dark environments is significantly
grimoire.eclipse.vampire.2.2:
§0enhanced, producing effects similar to Night Vision.
§4✦ Immunity§0
Common poisons show little or no effectiveness.
§c§lVAMPIRE: BLOOD AND WEAKNESSES
§0Blood appears to play an essential role
grimoire.eclipse.vampire.3.1:
§0in maintaining the vampiric condition. 
 
To drain a creature:
Sneak and right-click while holding an empty hand.

§4§lFATAL WEAKNESSES§0

Sunlight causes progressive combustion
grimoire.eclipse.vampire.3.2:
progressively.
Attacks with §7Silver§0 deal §c3×§0 normal damage.
§8Author's Note: §0The vulnerability to silver is particularly consistent. Unlike other weaknesses attributed to vampires in popular accounts,
grimoire.eclipse.werewolf.1.1:
this one can be reliably reproduced.
§6§lII. PATH OF THE WOLF
§0Lycanthropy can be contracted after surviving an attack by an §6Alpha§0.
Transformation manifests forcibly during the nights of the §6Full Moon§0.
grimoire.eclipse.werewolf.2.1:
§6§lWEREWOLF: ADVANTAGES
§6✦ Regeneration§0
Wound recovery is accelerated, even during combat.
§6✦ Claws§0
§0The transformation produces natural weapons capable of dealing high unarmed damage.
grimoire.eclipse.werewolf.2.2:
§6✦ Agility§0
Jumps and running speed are superior to those of an ordinary human.
§6§lWEREWOLF: WEAKNESSES
§6✦ Vulnerabilities§0
Accelerated hunger.
Sensitivity to §1Holy Water§0 and §7Silver§0.
grimoire.eclipse.werewolf.3.1: §8Author's Note: §0Among the creatures studied, werewolves exhibit one of the clearest relationships between altered physiology and predatory behavior.
grimoire.eclipse.hunters.1.1:
§3§lIII. ORDER OF SILVER
§0The Hunters' Order is made up of humans who reject or combat supernatural manifestations.
The Order has accumulated knowledge about anomalous creatures through successive generations
grimoire.eclipse.hunters.1.2:
of hunting and experimentation.
§3§lJOINING THE ORDER
§0Deliver §75 Pure Silvers§0 to the Hunt Master, present at the Garrison.
§8Author's Note: §0The Order seems to treat silver not only as a weapon but also as a material for study.
grimoire.eclipse.hunters.2.1:
Its experience surpasses, in some cases, any known explanation.
§3§lHUNTERS: ARSENAL I

§7✦ Silver Sword§0
Interferes with the natural regeneration of monsters.

§6✦ Stake Crossbow§0
Deals critical damage to vampires.
grimoire.eclipse.hunters.2.2:
§3§lHUNTERS: ARSENAL II

§1✦ Holy Water§0
Creates a purification area capable of harming undead creatures.

§8✦ Bear Trap§0
Immobilizes the target and applies Slowness III.
grimoire.eclipse.cultists.1.1:
§5§lIV. CULT OF THE ABYSS
§0The Cult of the Abyss is devoted to manipulating forces considered incompatible with the known laws of nature.
Their methods include dark magic, summoning, and sacrifice.
grimoire.eclipse.cultists.1.2:
§5§lREQUIREMENTS
§0Wear the complete §5Cultist Robe§0 set and read the §5Tome of Shadows§0.
§5§lCULTISTS: SACRIFICES§0
Use the §5Unholy Altar§0 to sacrifice passive creatures and gain favor from the shadows.
grimoire.eclipse.cultists.2.1:
§c§lWarning:§0
You will lose all reputation with the §3Hunters' Order§0.
§8Author's Note: §0I was unable to determine whether the so-called “favor from the shadows” constitutes a measurable form of energy
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.1:
§2§lV. BESTIARY
§0The classification below was organized by apparent origin and observed behavior.
The designation of some creatures remains provisional.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.2:
§2§lBESTIARY: TERRESTRIAL
§2✦ Ash Ghoul§0
A corpse of anomalous nature associated with ashes and regions of intense thermal activity.
It displays signs of advanced decomposition.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.3:
§c✦ Blood Worm§0
A cavernous parasite specialized in draining the vitality of living organisms.
§8Record obtained: §cBlood Gland§0.
§2✦ Dried Corpse§0
A severely dehydrated human corpse.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.4:
§0It demonstrates unusual resistance to fire.
§8Record obtained: §0Corrupted Bone§0.
§2✦ Mapinguari§0
A large creature of unknown origin, primarily associated with forest regions.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.5:
§0Reports describe territorial behavior and high aggression.
§2✦ Mist Ghoul§0
A predator frequently found in areas covered by mist.
Its behavior favors discreet approaches.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.6:
§2✦ Sulfur Hound§0
A canid of anomalous nature associated with sulfur compounds and environments of high thermal activity.
§4✦ Wendigo§0
A large humanoid creature associated with regions of extreme cold.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.1.7:
§0It is found primarily in icy biomes and snowy forests.
§8Record obtained: §4Wendigo's Horn§0.
§8Author's Note: §0The presence of creatures resembling figures from ancient traditions and legends is far too common to be ignored.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.2.1: §0It remains unknown whether these legends originated from real encounters or whether the Abyss simply reproduces concepts that already exist.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.2.2:
§2§lBESTIARY: ETHEREAL
§3✦ Forest Wraith§0
A wraith associated with forests.
Insufficient data to detail its effects.
§8Record obtained: §3Ectoplasmic Dust§0.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.2.3:
§5✦ Ghost§0
An incorporeal entity resistant to most conventional physical attacks.
§7Silver§0 demonstrates exceptional effectiveness against its manifestation.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.3.1:
§8Record obtained: §7Spectral Shroud§0.
§8Author's Note: §0Ghosts defy any purely biological classification. It is unclear whether we are observing an organism, a remnant of consciousness, or an independent manifestation.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.3.2:
§2§lBESTIARY: ABYSSAL
§5✦ Abyssal Hand§0
A manifestation of unknown origin, identified by its extremely unusual anatomy.
Its form suggests the possibility that it may constitute only an extension of a larger entity.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.3.3:
§5✦ Aether Parasite§0
A parasitic organism with anomalous structure.
Its relationship with energy sources remains inconclusive.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.3.4:
§5✦ Corrupted Saci§0
A corrupted entity associated with supernatural manifestations of apparently folkloric origin.
Its nature suggests contact with or influence from the Abyss.
It demonstrates a certain distorted sense of humor.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.3.5:
§6✦ Flame Imp§0
A small entity of fiery nature.
It shows a strong association with heat and combustion.
§5✦ Abyssal Watcher§0
An abyssal entity capable of firing concentrated beams of energy.
grimoire.eclipse.bestiary.3.6: §8Author's Note: §0Creatures classified as abyssal exhibit the highest degree of anatomical irregularity. Some do not even appear to obey the common distinction between matter and energy.
grimoire.eclipse.eclipse.1.1:
§4§lVI. THE ECLIPSE
§0The Eclipse is a phenomenon of extraordinary occurrence associated with the weakening of the separation between the known world and the §5Abyss§0.
During its manifestation,
grimoire.eclipse.eclipse.1.2:
§0environmental and supernatural alterations become significantly more frequent.
The sky takes on an abnormal coloration, darkness intensifies, and abyssal manifestations become possible.
grimoire.eclipse.eclipse.1.3: §8Author's Note: §0I do not consider the Eclipse to be a simple astronomical alteration. The coincidence between the phenomenon and the increase in abyssal manifestations is statistically difficult to ignore.
grimoire.eclipse.rituals.1.1:
§4§lVII. RITUALS AND ALTARS
§4✦ BLOOD ALTAR§0
A structure composed of §8Blood Bricks§0, with a central basin.
Use a §cDagger§0 to convert XP into Extra Life Potions.
grimoire.eclipse.rituals.1.2: §8Author's Note: §0The conversion of experience into functional matter remains without a satisfactory explanation. The process appears to use blood as an intermediary.
grimoire.eclipse.rituals.2.1:
§4§lALTARS:

§3✦ MOON ALTAR§0
Built with:
4 Quartz Pillars
§01 Silver Slab
When exposed to moonlight, the altar transforms Silver into §3Blessed Silver§0.
grimoire.eclipse.rituals.2.2: §8Author's Note: §0The reaction does not occur simply through the presence of the Moon. The altar appears to act as a mechanism for concentrating or modifying lunar energy.
grimoire.eclipse.rituals.3.1:
§5§lABYSS PORTAL
§0§lPROCEDURE§0
1. Place the §5Altar Core§0 in the center.
2. Draw a 3×3 circle using §5Ritual Chalk§0.
§8Author's Note: §0This information is incomplete and inconclusive at the present time.
grimoire.eclipse.abyss.1.1:
§5§lVIII. THE ABYSS
§0A fragmented dimension suspended in an apparently eternal void.
Its geography is unstable and its physical properties differ significantly from those observed in the known world.
grimoire.eclipse.abyss.1.2:
§0The air is highly toxic.
Survival requires the §5Cultist Mask§0 or a monstrous physiology capable of withstanding the environment.
Beds explode violently.
grimoire.eclipse.abyss.2.1:
§5§lTHE ABYSS: DANGERS AND RESOURCES
§0In the deepest regions, the rare ore §5Tenebrium§0 can be found.
§8Author's Note: §0The Abyss appears less like a natural place and more like an incomplete structure.
grimoire.eclipse.abyss.2.2:
§0Fragments of environments exist side by side without obeying conventional geographic logic.
§6§lIX. ABILITIES AND XP
§0Press §6[K]§0 to open the stats.
grimoire.eclipse.skills.1:
§0Gain §6Points§0 by eliminating rival mobs or completing missions.
§6§lNOTABLE ABILITIES
§6✦ Bat Form§0
Allows temporary flight for 15 seconds.
grimoire.eclipse.skills.2:
§6✦ War Cry§0
Grants Strength II to the group.
§3✦ Silver Mastery§0
Grants +30% silver-related damage and durability.
§8Author's Note: §0The origin of the Points remains unknown.
grimoire.eclipse.skills.3:
§0However, their acquisition is clearly tied to experience accumulated through conflict and survival.
§7§lX. THE SILVER FORGE
§0Common silver has insufficient durability for advanced combat applications.
grimoire.eclipse.silver_forge.1:
§0The Hunter's Forge allows it to undergo a purification process.
§7§lPROCEDURE§0
Smelt Silver in the Hunter's Forge using §6Blaze Powder§0 to synthesize §7Pure Silver§0.
grimoire.eclipse.silver_forge.2: §8Author's Note: §0The result is not merely more durable silver. Its effectiveness against certain creatures suggests a change in the material's fundamental properties.
grimoire.eclipse.commands.1:
§4§lXI. USEFUL COMMANDS
§3/eclipse stats§0
Shows your level and thirst.
§3/eclipse fac reset§0
Resets your faction. Cost: 30 XP.
grimoire.eclipse.final.1:
§4§lFINAL AUTHOR'S NOTE I
§0Much of what is recorded in this tome remains incomplete. §0The creatures can be observed. The rituals can be repeated. The effects can be measured.
grimoire.eclipse.final.2:
But the origin of all this remains obscure.
 
§4FINAL AUTHOR'S NOTE II: §0There is one hypothesis I have been unable to eliminate after years of investigation: perhaps we are making the mistake of studying the Abyss as a place.
grimoire.eclipse.final.3: Perhaps it is a process. §0And, if this hypothesis is correct, the creatures, the rituals, and even the Eclipse may be only symptoms of something far greater.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_sentidos_vampirico: Marks nearby supernatural creatures within 16 blocks with a particle above their heads, visible only to you; identifies their type in the action bar when aiming at them.
Bites the aimed target, dealing 2 damage and restoring 0.5 HP + 0.5 Energy.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_visao_noturna.name: Night Vision
skill.eclipse.vampiro_visao_noturna.desc: Grants night vision while you are a vampire.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_regeneracao_sangui: Doubles the healing provided by the Vampire Blood Bottle. Vampiric Fangs already have their own healing effect.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_passo_sombrio.name: Shadow Step
skill.eclipse.vampiro_passo_sombrio.desc: Performs a rapid dash of approximately 3 blocks. Passing through blocks during use is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_fome_de_sangue.des: For 15s, increases damage, speed and resistance by 2x. The vampiric hunger cost is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_flecha_de_sangue.d: A ranged attack with a range of up to 12 blocks that deals 3 damage.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_dominacao_sanguine: Affects a 7x7 area for 10s, applying simplified effects based on creature type. Does not affect bosses.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_forma_de_nevoa.des: For 5s, you can pass through blocks and creatures, take no damage, and deal 2.5 damage to each mob you pass through.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_regeneracao_superi: Doubles the healing of the Vampire Blood Bottle again. The full hunger condition is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_hipnose.name: Hypnosis
skill.eclipse.vampiro_hipnose.descriptio: Nearby humanoids receive Slowness II and Weakness I for 5s. During this time, player damage is multiplied by 2.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_velocidade_sobrena: For 15s, grants 2.5x movement speed. Jump and attack speed are not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_senhor_do_sangue.d: For 15s, increases damage, speed and resistance by 3x. 3x regeneration is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.vampiro_ascensao_vampirica: For 25s, grants 4x speed, 6x resistance and 3.5x damage. Nearby mobs glow. 5x regeneration is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_instinto_bestial: Allows you to perceive nearby creatures. The effect is not yet implemented and requires rendering.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_olfato_predatori: Creates a trail of red particles around supernatural creatures within 10 blocks, becoming more intense as they are more wounded.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_resistencia_best: Reduces received damage to 0.75x its normal value.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_investida.name: Charge
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_investida.descri: Charges forward 3 blocks, deals 1 damage and knocks the target back 2.5 blocks.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_furia.name: Fury
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_furia.descriptio: For 15s, increases strength, speed and resistance by 2x.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_regeneracao_best: Restores 1 HP whenever a melee attack hits.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_rugido_intimidad: Affects creatures within a 7-block radius, applying a form of paralysis for 2s through extreme Slowness.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_transformacao_pa: For 60s, grants 3x strength, 2.5x resistance and 2.5x speed. Claw bleeding is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_salto_predatorio: Performs a directed leap of approximately 8 to 10 blocks and deals 3 area damage upon landing without taking fall damage.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_furia_lunar.name: Lunar Fury
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_furia_lunar.desc: At night, applies a damage, speed and resistance multiplier based on the moon phase, from 2x during the Full Moon to 0.5x during the New Moon. Duration is not yet defined.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_predador_alfa.de: Grants 3x damage, 2x speed and 2x resistance. Enhanced senses and bonuses against weaker creatures are not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_forma_alfa.name: Alpha Form
skill.eclipse.lobisomem_forma_alfa.descr: For 60s, grants 6x strength, 5x resistance and 4x speed. Special attacks and an enhanced roar are not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_conhecimento_de_: Marks nearby supernatural creatures within 16 blocks with a particle and identifies their type in the action bar when aiming at them.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_treinamento_com_: Grants 25% additional damage with silver weapons against supernatural creatures.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_rastreador.name: Tracker
skill.eclipse.cacadores_rastreador.descr: Creates a trail of red particles around supernatural creatures within 10 blocks.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_golpe_preciso.de: The next melee strike within 5s receives a +3 damage bonus.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_armadilha_de_cac: Creates a red mark on the ground that attracts supernatural creatures within 10 blocks and applies extreme Slowness for 5s when they approach.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_preparacao_alqui: Grants 3 Holy Waters when unlocked. The Holy Water recipe remains available for crafting.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_marca_do_cacador: Marks the aimed target, applying Weakness I and Slowness I for 30s. The visual icon and additional damage are not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_armadilha_de_pra: Uses the same base as Hunter's Trap. Extra damage and specific effects have not yet been defined.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_conhecimento_ana: Increases damage against supernatural creatures by 15%.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_municao_especial: Grants the Special Bow with 5 durability. Its arrows deal +3 damage against supernatural creatures.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_ritual_de_conten: Affects supernatural creatures within a 5-block radius, applying Slowness II and Weakness I for 10s.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_mestre_cacador.d: Grants +1 damage against supernatural creatures, +1 silver efficiency and makes marks last 2x longer. Some effects are not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cacadores_arsenal_do_exter: For 30s, grants Strength IV and Resistance III. Additional bonuses for silver, ammunition and supernatural damage are not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_conhecimento_pro: Allows interaction with hidden content. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_marca_do_culto.d: Recognizes cult symbols, locations and structures. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_sussurros_do_abi: Allows you to perceive signs of the Abyss. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_pequeno_ritual.d: Grants a generic temporary benefit. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_sacrificio.name: Sacrifice
skill.eclipse.cultistas_sacrificio.descr: Sacrifices 5 health to restore 100% of Abyssal Energy or Corruption.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_corrupcao_contro: Permanently increases the maximum Abyssal Energy or Corruption by 10.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_ritual_de_invoca: Costs 15 Corruption and summons 3 empowered zombies for 15s, with 1.5x health and immunity to sunlight. They remain hostile to the player.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_pacto_abissal.de: Costs 5 Corruption and grants 3x damage, speed and resistance for 20s.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_ritual_maior.des: A more powerful area ritual. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_olho_do_abismo.d: Allows you to perceive entities, corruption and abyssal phenomena. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_invocacao_superi: Costs 45 Corruption and summons 2 Iron Golems for 10s. Allied AI is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_voz_do_abismo.de: Manipulates creatures and phenomena of the Abyss. The effect is not yet implemented.
skill.eclipse.cultistas_ritual_do_eclips: Consumes the Eclipse Essence in your hand and all Corruption to trigger the Global Eclipse, forcing a storm and keeping the world at night for 15 minutes.
